name: Priest of the Sleeping God
originalText:
### Priest of the Sleeping God

- **Path Type:** Novice
- **Source:** Seekers of the Sleeping God
- **Source Page:** 7
- **PDF Page:** 7

```text
Priest of the Sleeping God
(Novice)
As much as the Sleeping God’s followers would remake
the cult of Oceanus, many underlying ideas about the god
and its role in the world remain unchanged. Followers see
the god as a violent entity who must be appeased to find
success fishing, survive crossings, and keep dangerous
creatures in the waters at bay. Most rituals involve
sacrificing blood, wine, and people to the waters. The
efficacy of these acts varies.

Priests wear blue-gray vestments and squid-headed
masks that differentiate them from other followers of
Oceanus. Most carry staffs with squid heads at the top.
Many also wear jewelry made from pearls, coral, sand
dollars, and other relics from the sea.

Traditions associated with the cult include Madness,
Storm, and Water.

LEVEL 1 PRIEST OF THE SLEEPING GOD
Attributes: Increase two attribute scores by 1 each.
Characteristics: Health +4, Power +1
Languages and Professions: You either read one language
you can speak or add one language to the list of
languages you can speak. Also, add cultist to your list of
professions.
Magic: You discover the Madness, Storm, or Water
tradition. Then, choose one benefit from the following
options:
• You discover the other two traditions.
• You discover one of the other traditions and learn one
spell
• You learn two spells.
Insane Recovery: You can use an action to gain 1d3
Insanity. For each point of Insanity gained in this way,
choose one creature within short range. The target heals
damage equal to their healing rate. Rather than become
frightened from gaining Insanity in this way, you
become impaired for a number of rounds equal to your
Insanity total. You then lose access to this talent until
you complete a rest.

LEVEL 2 PRIEST OF THE SLEEPING GOD
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: Choose one benefit from the following options:
• You discover two traditions from the following:
Madness, Storm, or Water.
• You discover one tradition from the following:
Madness, Storm, or Water. You learn one spell.
• You learn two spells.
Tidal Prayers: When you or another creature within short
range starts their turn, you can use a triggered action
to move that creature a number of yards equal to your
Power score. Then, until the end of that creature’s turn,
the first attack roll or challenge roll they make is made
with 1 boon.

LEVEL 5 PRIEST OF THE SLEEPING GOD
Characteristics: Health +4, Power +1
Magic: You learn one spell.
Unhinged Strength: Whenever you gain Insanity, your
attacks deal 1d6 extra damage for 1 minute.

LEVEL 8 PRIEST OF THE SLEEPING GOD
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: You learn one spell.
Call of the Sleeping God: You can use this talent at the
start of your turn to create an appalling groaning noise
as if the god you serve was awakening. Each creature
within medium range makes a Strength and Will
challenge roll. On a failed Strength challenge roll, you
pull the creature a number of yards toward you equal
to your Power score. On a failed Will challenge roll, the
target gains 1 Insanity. You then heal damage equal to
the total amount of Insanity gained by all targets of this
talent. Once you use this talent, you lose access to it
until after you complete a rest.
```
